50:Fixes:
51-
52- * [#236](https://github.com/mity/md4c/issues/236):
53-   Fix quadratic time behavior caused by one-by-one walking over block lines
54-   instead of calling `md_lookup_line()`.
55-
56- * [#238](https://github.com/mity/md4c/issues/238):
57-   Fix quadratic time and output size behavior caused by malicious misuse of
58-   link reference definitions.
59-
60: * [#242](https://github.com/mity/md4c/issues/242):
61-   The strike-through extension (with flag `MD_FLAG_STRIKETHROUGH`) now follows
62-   same logic as other emphasis spans in respect to punctuation character and
63-   word boundaries.
64-
65- * [#248](https://github.com/mity/md4c/issues/248):
66-   Fix handling tab when removing trailing whitespace, especially in connection
67-   with ATX headers.
68-
69- * [#266](https://github.com/mity/md4c/issues/266):
70-   We now correctly abort the parser when a callback returns non-zero.
71-   (Previously it worked correctly only for negative values, values greater
72-   than zero were causing strange and inconsistent behavior.)
73-
74- * [#271](https://github.com/mity/md4c/issues/271):
75-   Fix handling a code span whose closer is on the next line and yet another
76-   text follows. In the case we erroneously outputted the closer code span mark
77-   as part of the text.
78-
79- * [#275](https://github.com/mity/md4c/issues/275):
80-   Fix `md_decode_utf16le_before__()`. (Only affected MD4C builds built with
81-   `-MD4C_USE_UTF16` on Windows.)
82-
83- * [#278](https://github.com/mity/md4c/issues/278),
84-   [#294](https://github.com/mity/md4c/issues/294):
85-   Do not try to interpret characters in a link URL as Markdown syntax
86-   characters.
87-
88- * [#292](https://github.com/mity/md4c/issues/292):
89-   Fix detection of closing code block fence if it has a trailing tabulator.
90-
91- * [#299](https://github.com/mity/md4c/issues/299):
92-   Fix invalid `free()` in an error path.

95-## Version 0.5.2
96-
97-Changes:
98-
99- * Changes mandated by CommonMark specification 0.31:
100-
101-   - The specification expands set of Unicode characters seen by Markdown
102-     parser as a punctuation. Namely all Unicode general categories P
103-     (punctuation) and S (symbols) are now seen as such.
104-
105-   - The definition of HTML comment has been changed so that `<!-->` and
106-     `<!--->` are also recognized as HTML comments.
107-
108-   - HTML tags recognized as HTML block starting condition of type 4 has been
109-     updated, namely a tag `<source>` has been removed, whereas `<search>`
110-     added.
111-
112-   Refer to [CommonMark 0.31.2](https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/) for full
113-   specification.
114-
115:Fixes:
116-
117- * [#230](https://github.com/mity/md4c/issues/230):
118-   The fix [#223](https://github.com/mity/md4c/issues/223) in 0.5.1 release
119-   was incomplete and one corner case remained unfixed. This is now addressed.
120-
121- * [#231](https://github.com/mity/md4c/issues/231):
122-   `md2html --full-html` now emits `<meta charset="UTF-8">` in the HTML header.

125-## Version 0.5.1
126-
127-Changes:
128-
129- * LaTeX math extension (`MD_FLAG_LATEXMATHSPANS`) now requires that opener
130-   mark is not immediately preceded with alpha-numeric character and similarly
131-   that closer mark is not immediately followed with alpha-numeric character.
132-
133-   So for example `foo$ x + y = z $` is not recognized as LaTeX equation
134-   anymore because there is no space between `foo` and the opening `$`.
135-
136- * Table extension (`MD_FLAG_TABLES`) now recognizes only tables with no more
137-   than 128 columns. This limit has been imposed to prevent a pathological
138-   case of quadratic output size explosion which could be used as DoS attack
139-   vector.
140-
141- * We are now more strict with `MD_FLAG_PERMISSIVExxxAUTOLINKS` family of
142-   extensions with respect to non-alphanumeric characters, with the aim to
143-   mitigate false positive detections.
144-
145-   Only relatively few selected non-alphanumeric are now allowed in permissive
146-   e-mail auto-links (`MD_FLAG_PERMISSIVEEMAILAUTOLINKS`):
147-     - `.`, `-`, `_`, `+` in user name part of e-mail address; and
148-     - `.`, `-`, `_` in host part of the e-mail address.
